mentions.name: Dynamic Topological GPU Execution Model
mentions.description: A dynamic topological algorithm paired with a matching GPU-side execution model, exploring how changing task structure can drive a correspondingly changing compute flow instead of forcing all work through a fixed pipeline.
mentions.problem: Existing approaches force all compute through a fixed pipeline even when the task structure changes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been exploring whether changing task structure should lead to changing compute flow as well, instead of forcing everything through a fixed pipeline. One direction I’m thinking about is a dynamic topological algorithm together with a matching GPU-side execution model.

evidence.value: I’ve been exploring whether changing task structure should lead to changing compute flow as well, instead of forcing everything through a fixed pipeline. One direction I’m thinking about is a dynamic topological algorithm together with a matching GPU-side execution model.
